title: Audio serverless worker output (audio-serverless/v1)
description: Result of one SFX/music/layer job: the produced audio (exactly one of audio_b64 or audio_url) and execution-fact telemetry. Expected values from input.parameter are never substituted.

audio_b64.description: Base64-encoded audio bytes (WAV or FLAC) for results within OUTPUT_INLINE_MAX_MB / OUTPUT_INLINE_BUDGET_MB.

audio_url.description: Presigned HTTP(S) URL for results uploaded to S3-compatible storage (S3_*, OUTPUT_URL_TTL_SECONDS).

telemetry.description: Execution-fact telemetry: measured by the worker from the executed graph, the produced audio bytes and the pinned model manifest. input.parameter values are never substituted.

engine_version.description: Pinned model/engine version of the executed model file (models-manifest.txt version column), e.g. stable-audio-3-small-sfx@2026-05.

model_hash.description: Measured sha256 of the executed model weight file (loader node -> file name -> volume file), prefixed with sha256:.

seed.description: Seed read from the executed sampler graph (KSampler.seed, RandomNoise.noise_seed, ...).

duration_seconds.description: Fact duration of the produced audio read from its header (WAV/FLAC), not the requested duration.

sample_rate.description: Fact sample rate of the produced audio, from its header.

channels.description: Fact channel count of the produced audio, from its header.

gpu_seconds.description: Measured wall-clock seconds of the graph execution (submit -> history completion -> output fetch).

license.description: License identifier of the executed model file, from the pinned manifest row (e.g. Stability-AI-Community, MIT, Apache-2.0).
